description: Historical flood map series—Queensland is a dataset listed in Queensland Government open data portal (data.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Natural Resources and Mines, Manufacturing and Regional and Rural Development. Collection of flood and inundation maps over Queensland at various scales 1893-1974, these show flood levels and probable inundation areas at various flood heights. A number of the map series include key maps. Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under the publisher Natural Resources and Mines, Manufacturing and Regional and Rural Development. Its tags are cadastral, county, flood, historical, image. It offers 9 resource(s) in csv, txt, wms. The portal shows 2026-04-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-queensland-government-open-data-portal.
